src/apprt.zig)\n    |-- Runtime chooses window/tab/split/pane; delivers events\n    `-- Core Surface (src/Surface.zig): owns one terminal session\n        |-- app / rt_app / rt_surface: borrowed references, not owned hosts\n        |-- config: owned DerivedConfig\n        |   `-- updateConfig -> derived settings to I/O and renderer mailboxes\n        |-- keyboard / mouse / size / focused / visible / child_exited\n        |-- keyCallback / textCallback / mouseButtonCallback\n        |   |-- Binding action -> local operation or rt_app.performAction\n        |   |-- Encode key/mouse/paste using io.terminal protocol state\n        |   `-- queueIo -> io.queueMessage; takes ownership; readonly drops writes\n        |-- sizeCallback -> resize: pixels + cell metrics + padding\n        |   `-- -> queueIo(.resize) AND renderer mailbox .resize + wakeup\n        |-- io: termio.Termio (src/termio/Termio.zig)\n        |   |-- backend: Backend.exec -> Exec -> subprocess + PTY\n        |   |-- terminal_stream: terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)\n        |   |-- terminal: terminal.Terminal (the sole emulation state)\n        |   `-- mailbox / derived config / current size\n        |-- io_thread: termio.Thread manager; io_thr: OS thread\n        |   `-- drainMailbox -> io.queueWrite; coalesces resize requests\n        |-- renderer_state: renderer.State (src/renderer/State.zig)\n        |   |-- terminal -> &io.terminal; NOT another owned terminal\n        |   |-- mutex + preedit + renderer-facing mouse state\n        |   `-- lockDemand / unlockDemand / yieldToDemand: fairness handoff\n        |-- renderer: GenericRenderer(GraphicsAPI)\n        |   `-- Own frame state; borrow App device and shared font grid\n        |-- renderer_thread: renderer.Thread manager; renderer_thr: OS thread\n        |   `-- Wakeups/timers -> renderer.updateFrame / drawFrame\n        |-- draw() -> renderer.drawFrame(true), also from main thread\n        |-- Optional search worker and inspector\n        |-- childExited(): record exit; native UI or terminal text\n        |   |-- Abnormally short run -> report and return, keep surface open\n        |   `-- Normal exit: wait_after_command holds; otherwise close()\n        |-- close() -> rt_surface.close(needsConfirmQuit())\n        |   `-- Runtime close lifecycle -> Surface.deinit()\n        `-- deinit(): ordered release\n            |-- Stop/join search, then renderer thread, then I/O thread\n            |-- I/O thread exit -> Exec stops child and joins PTY reader\n            |-- Free renderer before renderer_thread, then I/O resources\n            `-- Release input/preedit/mutex/config;
